otomasyon.aciklama: "When this happens, do that": automatic emails, notifications, tasks and webhooks on your account's events (support tickets, invoices, tasks, bookings…).
otomasyon.aciklamaYonetici: "When this happens, do that": email, notification, task, CRM and support actions on every account's events. Rules run in the background; every run is logged.

kural.bos: No rules yet. Start from a ready-made template or create a new rule.
kural.silOnay: Delete the rule "{{ad}}"? (It can be restored from the trash.)

duzenleyici.tetikAciklama: Which event should start the rule?
duzenleyici.kosulAciklama: Optional: run only when the conditions match. Without conditions it runs on every event.
duzenleyici.kosulYok: No conditions — the rule runs every time this event happens.
duzenleyici.eylemAciklama: Actions run in order (at most {{sayi}}). Actions after "Wait" continue when the time comes.
duzenleyici.degiskenIpucu: Click a text field first, then pick a variable; it is inserted at the cursor. Values are inserted safely (HTML-escaped).
duzenleyici.once_alan_sec: Click the text field where the variable should go first.
duzenleyici.bekleDenetimAciklama: After each "Wait" step the conditions are checked again against the record's current state; if they no longer hold, the remaining actions are skipped (e.g. no reminder if the invoice was paid in the meantime). The outcome shows in the run log.

olayAciklama.aday_olusturuldu: Lead from a form, contact, site analysis or added manually.
olayAciklama.aday_asama_degisti: The lead moved to another pipeline stage.
olayAciklama.fatura_odendi: The invoice was marked as paid.
olayAciklama.fatura_gecikti: An open invoice is 1, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days overdue (once per threshold).
olayAciklama.destek_olusturuldu: New ticket from the panel, the site or email.
olayAciklama.destek_yanitlandi: A new message was written on a ticket.
olayAciklama.gorev_olusturuldu: A task was added to a project.
olayAciklama.proje_asama_degisti: The project moved to another stage.
olayAciklama.menu_siparis: An order came from a QR menu / catalog.
olayAciklama.kart_mesaj: A message came from a digital business card.
olayAciklama.icerik_onaylandi: The post was approved by the client or within the team.
olayAciklama.icerik_revizyon_istendi: The client requested a revision from the approval link or the panel (note included).
olayAciklama.icerik_yayin_zamani: The scheduled time of an approved post arrived (once per post).
olayAciklama.icerik_yayinlandi: The post was manually marked as published.
olayAciklama.randevu_olusturuldu: A new booking on the booking page.
olayAciklama.is_emri_olusturuldu: A field service work order was opened (manually, from the maintenance list or from a booking).
olayAciklama.is_emri_tamamlandi: The technician finished the job; the person in the event is the service customer.
olayAciklama.etkinlik_kayit: An event registration was confirmed (paid ones once payment arrives).
olayAciklama.etkinlik_bilet_satildi: Payment for a paid ticket order was received (agency events only).
olayAciklama.etkinlik_giris: A ticket was scanned at the door (first entry).
olayAciklama.etkinlik_iptal: The attendee or the organiser cancelled a ticket.
olayAciklama.teklif_yanitsiz: A sent quote has had no accept or decline for 3 or 7 days (once per threshold; resending restarts the count).
olayAciklama.aday_hareketsiz: An open lead has had no activity (note, call, stage change…) for 7 or 14 days. New activity resets the count.
olayAciklama.pos_satis: A sale was completed at the till (once per receipt; no customer name in the context).
olayAciklama.stok_kritik: A product's total stock fell to its threshold (once until it rises above it again).
olayAciklama.egitim_kayit: A student enrolled or joined the waiting list (form, manual or CSV); for under-18s the contact person is the parent.
olayAciklama.egitim_tamamlandi: A certificate was issued to the student (automatically when conditions are met, or manually).
olayAciklama.egitim_devamsizlik: The student missed the set number of classes (once per student).
olayAciklama.ik_izin_talebi: An employee sent a leave request, or a pending request was created in the panel (sick leave: dates only).
olayAciklama.ik_izin_karari: A pending leave request was approved or declined (also leave added directly as approved).
olayAciklama.muhasebe_butce_asildi: In bookkeeping, this month's actual spending in an expense category went over its budget (once per category and month).
olayAciklama.muhasebe_alacak_gecikti: A contact's receivable in bookkeeping is 1, 30, 60 or 90 days past due (once per open item and threshold). The “person in the event” is the contact.
olayAciklama.ortaklik_basvuru: An application arrived from the /ortaklik page (awaiting a decision).
olayAciklama.ortaklik_komisyon: A referred customer's invoice was paid (commission) or refunded / its payment reversed (reversal entry).
olayAciklama.ortaklik_odeme_talebi: A partner asked for their approved balance to be paid out.
olayAciklama.toplanti_planlandi: A new meeting was created in the admin panel. The “person in the event” is the client account, or the CRM lead if there is no account.
olayAciklama.toplanti_yapildi: The meeting was marked as held (e.g. send a thank-you email or create a minutes task).
olayAciklama.toplanti_iptal: The meeting was cancelled with a reason; attendees received a cancellation (ICS).

eposta.nitelikIpucu: Marketing email only goes to recipients who gave marketing consent; otherwise the action is skipped and logged.

gorev.sonTarihIpucu: Leave empty for no due date.

webhook.ucYok: Add an endpoint in the "API and webhooks" tab first.
webhook.etiketIpucu: Sent as event type otomasyon.<label> (e.g. new_lead).

bekle.ipucu: The following actions continue via the scheduled job (roughly every 10 minutes).

neden.dongu: Loop prevented (a rule cannot trigger itself)
neden.kayit_yok: The event's record no longer exists
neden.zaten_asamada: Lead is already in this stage
neden.kosul_artik_saglanmiyor: Condition no longer met (re-checked after waiting)

yeni_aday_hosgeldin.aciklama: An informational welcome email to every new lead from a form or any other source.
yeni_aday_hosgeldin.govde:
Hello [[aday.ad|]],

Thank you for reaching out. We have received your request and will get back to you shortly.

Best regards

teklif_kabul_gorev.ad: Quote accepted → project task + team notification
teklif_kabul_gorev.aciklama: When a quote is accepted, a kick-off task due in 3 days is opened and a notification is sent.
teklif_kabul_gorev.bildirim_govde: [[teklif.baslik]] ([[teklif.genel_toplam]] [[teklif.para_birimi]]) was accepted. A kick-off task was opened.

fatura_gecikti_hatirlatma.ad: Invoice 30 days overdue → admin alert + CRM note
fatura_gecikti_hatirlatma.aciklama: When: an open invoice is 30 days past due (once per invoice). What it does: sends admins a panel notification and adds a note to the client's CRM record. Payment reminders to the client (+1, +7, +14 days) are already sent by the system; this rule sends the client no extra email.
fatura_gecikti_hatirlatma.bildirim_govde: [[hesap.ad|]] ([[hesap.email]]) — [[fatura.no]], [[fatura.tutar]] [[fatura.para_birimi]], due [[fatura.vade_tarihi]]. Automatic reminders (+1/+7/+14 days) were sent; a phone call may help now.
fatura_gecikti_hatirlatma.metin: Invoice [[fatura.no]] ([[fatura.tutar]] [[fatura.para_birimi]]) has been unpaid for 30 days.

destek_acil_bildirim.aciklama: Instant panel notification for a new ticket with "urgent" priority.
destek_acil_bildirim.govde: An urgent ticket was opened from the account [[hesap.email]] (#[[talep.id]]).

randevu_crm_etkinligi.aciklama: A meeting activity is added to the CRM lead of the person who booked.

teklif_yanitsiz_hatirlatma.ad: Quote unanswered for 3 days → gentle reminder
teklif_yanitsiz_hatirlatma.aciklama: When: a quote you sent gets no accept or decline within 3 days (once per quote). What it does: sends the person on the quote a polite reminder email and drops you a panel notification. You can edit the text as you like.
teklif_yanitsiz_hatirlatma.konu: A quick reminder about our quote: [[teklif.baslik]]
teklif_yanitsiz_hatirlatma.govde:
Hello [[kisi.ad|]],

A few days ago we shared our quote [[teklif.no]], "[[teklif.baslik]]". If you have any questions or would like something changed, simply reply to this email.

You can review the quote here: [[teklif.baglanti|the link in our first email]]

Best regards
teklif_yanitsiz_hatirlatma.bildirim_govde: [[teklif.baslik]] ([[teklif.genel_toplam]] [[teklif.para_birimi]]) — [[teklif.aday_ad|]] [[teklif.aday_eposta|]]. Viewed: [[teklif.goruntulendi]]. A gentle reminder email was sent to the client.

aday_hareketsiz_hatirlatma.ad: Lead quiet for 7 days → reminder to owner
aday_hareketsiz_hatirlatma.aciklama: When: an open CRM lead has no activity (note, call, stage change) for 7 days. What it does: sends a panel notification to the lead's owner (or admins if unassigned) and adds a note to the lead. Any new activity on the lead restarts the count.
aday_hareketsiz_hatirlatma.bildirim_govde: [[aday.ad]] [[aday.firma|]] — stage: [[aday.asama]], last activity: [[aday.son_hareket]]. Next step: [[aday.sonraki_adim|not set]].
aday_hareketsiz_hatirlatma.metin: No activity for 7 days; a reminder was sent to the owner.

proje_yayinda_geri_bildirim.aciklama: When: you move a project to the "Launch" stage. What it does: emails the client a thank-you that asks for their feedback. Everyone gets the same email (no different version for happy or unhappy clients — Google's rule). To add your Google review link, open the rule and edit the text.
proje_yayinda_geri_bildirim.govde:
Hello [[kisi.ad|]],

Your project [[proje.baslik]] is now live. Thank you so much for trusting us along the way.

We'd love to hear about your experience in a few sentences: what did you like, and what could we have done better? Simply reply to this email. If you like, you can also leave a public review of our business.

Best regards

sozlesme_imzalandi_bildirim.aciklama: When: a client signs a contract with e-signature. What it does: sends admins a "time to start" panel notification; if the contract came from a quote and that quote opened a project, it also adds a "request documents and access" task due in 2 days to the project (the task step is skipped when there is no project). The usual signature notification is still sent too.
sozlesme_imzalandi_bildirim.bildirim_govde: [[hesap.ad|]] ([[hesap.email]]) signed the contract "[[sozlesme.baslik]]". Next steps: schedule the kick-off meeting and request the documents and access you need.

icerik_onaylandi_gorev.aciklama: When: a content post managed by the agency is approved (clients' own content excluded). What it does: sends the content owner (or admins if none) a "Publish: <title>" panel notification; if a project is linked to the post, it also opens a "Publish" task in that project due the next day (without a linked project the task step is skipped). Link a project from the post's details in the content studio.
icerik_onaylandi_gorev.bildirim_govde: Post approved. Scheduled for: [[icerik.planlanan_at|not set]]; channels: [[icerik.kanallar|—]].

fatura_vade_oncesi_hatirlatma.ad: Invoice issued → reminder before due date if still open after 5 days
fatura_vade_oncesi_hatirlatma.aciklama: When: an invoice is issued; it waits 5 days and re-checks the conditions. What it does: if the invoice is still unpaid and due in at least 2 days, it sends the client a friendly "due date approaching" email. If it was paid in the meantime or the due date is too close, nothing is sent. The system's after-due reminders (+1, +7, +14 days) are separate; this rule only runs before the due date, so the same invoice never gets duplicate emails.
fatura_vade_oncesi_hatirlatma.govde:
Hello [[kisi.ad|]],

Your invoice [[fatura.no]] for [[fatura.tutar]] [[fatura.para_birimi]] is due on [[fatura.vade_tarihi]]. You can view it in your client panel.

If you have already paid, please disregard this email. If you have any questions, simply reply to this email.

Best regards

kart_mesaj_otomatik_yanit.ad: Business card message → automatic "we got your message" email
kart_mesaj_otomatik_yanit.aciklama: Anyone who writes to you through your digital business card's contact form with an email address immediately gets a short "we got your message" email. You are already notified of new messages.
kart_mesaj_otomatik_yanit.govde:
Hello [[mesaj.ad|]],

Your message from our digital business card has reached us. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.

Best regards

is_emri_acil_bildirim.aciklama: A panel notification arrives when a new work order with "urgent" priority is opened, so urgent jobs without a technician don't get missed.

sablon.onerilenAciklama: Suggested based on the industry pack applied to your account; it isn't set up automatically.

sistem.baslik: What the system does on its own
sistem.aciklama: Everything that runs in the background without you lifting a finger: the weekly summary, built-in flows and scheduled jobs. Your own "when this happens, do that" rules are in the Rules tab.

akis.aciklama: They run the moment something happens; change their settings in the related section.

talepCrm.aciklama: Anyone who writes via the contact form, pricing wizard, site analysis or embedded forms becomes a CRM lead; if the same person writes again it is added to their existing lead.

teklifKabul.ad: Accepted quotes open an invoice, contract and project
teklifKabul.aciklama: When a client accepts a quote, the records you chose for that quote (first invoice, contract draft, project) are created automatically.

destekKurallari.ad: Support requests are routed by rules
destekKurallari.aciklama: A new request is assigned to a team member based on its subject and source, gets a priority and tags, and can receive a canned reply.

projeAsama.ad: Clients hear about project stage changes
projeAsama.aciklama: When you move a project to the next stage, the client is informed in the panel and by email.

bildirimler.aciklama: Turn email, browser, SMS and WhatsApp channels on or off for each event; the weekly summary email is managed here too.

webhook.aciklama: Events such as a new lead or a paid invoice are sent instantly to systems you connect (Zapier, Make, etc.); failed deliveries are retried for 3 days.

ozet.aciklama: Every Monday morning admins get a summary of what needs attention this week: overdue invoices, open support requests, items waiting for a reply in the inbox, leads awaiting follow-up, unanswered quotes, content awaiting approval, pending documents, upcoming renewals and unreachable sites. Nothing is sent if everything is zero.
ozet.ilkTurda: at the next scheduled run (within 10 minutes)
ozet.epostaYok: The email channel is not ready (Resend or SMTP not set up, or switched off): the summary only appears in panel notifications.
ozet.tekKaynak: This switch is the same setting as the email box of the "Weekly summary" row in the Notifications section.
ozet.bos: Nothing needs attention right now — no summary would be sent this week.

bolum.gelen_kutusu: Waiting for a reply in the inbox
bolum.muhasebe: Bookkeeping: budget overruns and overdue receivables
bolum.ortaklik: Affiliates: pending applications and payout requests
